verdicts.title: Topological Complexity of the Klein bottle
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We show that the (normalized) topological complexity of the Klein bottle is $4$. We also show that, for any $g\geq 2$, $TC(N_g)=4$. This completes the recent work by Dranishnikov on the topological complexity of non-orientable surfaces.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns 'topological complexity' (Farber's TC invariant) of non-orientable surfaces, which is unrelated to the conjecture's claim about Poincaré duality indices being linearly correlated with communication complexity rank.

verdicts.title: On the geometry and topology of partial configuration spaces of Riemann surfaces
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We examine complements (inside products of a smooth projective complex curve of arbitrary genus) of unions of diagonals indexed by the edges of an arbitrary simple graph.
